title: Threat hunting: hypothesis, search and validation

videos.script: Every alert in this course so far was raised by a rule somebody wrote before the event. {{before}} Hunting starts from the other end. It assumes something got past the rules, and goes looking. {{assume}} Not at random. A hunt starts with a hypothesis, written down, specific enough to be wrong. Then the data that would show it, a search, and an honest check of what came back. {{check}} In this lesson you run three small hunts over the week. One finds something. One finds nothing, and that is a result too. And the third becomes a rule, so the next time nobody has to go looking. {{rule}}
